args.title: Fix validation for null amounts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/schema.ts

Ensure that the validation properly handles null amounts by throwing an appropriate IngestError if the amount is null. This addresses the case where the error message 'The amount is not a number' is triggered.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/schema.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The amount is validated against the schema, and if it is null, an IngestError with the key "errors.badAmount" is thrown, which corresponds to the message 'The amount is not a number'.
